text: I ran the requested check on pilot_library_v1.json (15 blueprints). The top page is always intensity 2 and is a plateau: the last peak page is page 6 in 9 blueprints and page 5 in 6 (of 8; page 5 of 6 for the age-3 blueprint), and pages 7-8 are always 0-1 because the arc must end on a permitted landing. So by last peak we already sit at the start of the last third; what differs is that our peaks are flat and often first appear on pages 2-4. No engine change; at most a reporting metric (first/last peak page) in the validator.
